facts.text: Appellant Gherulal Parakh and first respondent Mahadeodas Maiya, managers of two joint families, entered into a partnership to carry on wagering contracts with Messrs. Mulchand Gulzarimull and Baldeosahay Surajmull of Hapur.

anchor.surface_text: The appellant, Gherulal Parakh, and the first respondent, Mahadeodas Maiya, managers of two joint families entered into a partnership to carry on wagering companytracts with two firms of Hapur, namely, Messrs. Mulchand Gulzarimull and Baldeosahay Surajmull.

facts.text: Partners agreed that contracts would be made in the name of the respondents on behalf of the firm and profit and loss borne equally.

anchor.surface_text: It was agreed between the partners that the said companytracts would be made in the name of the respondents on behalf of the firm and that the profit and loss resulting from the transactions would be borne by them in equal shares.

facts.text: First respondent entered into 32 contracts with Mulchand and 49 contracts with Baldeosahay.

anchor.surface_text: In implementation of the said agreement, the first respondent entered into 32 companytracts with Mulchand and 49 companytracts with Baldeosahay and the nett result of all these transactions was a loss,

facts.text: Net result of transactions was a loss, first respondent paid entire amount due to Hapur merchants.

anchor.surface_text: and the nett result of all these transactions was a loss, with the result that the first respondent had to pay to the Hapur merchants the entire amount due to them.

facts.text: Appellant denied liability to bear his share of the loss.

anchor.surface_text: As the appellant denied his liability to bear his share of the loss,

facts.text: First respondent along with his sons filed O.S. No. 18 of 1937 in Subordinate Judge, Darjeeling for half loss in Mulchand transactions.

anchor.surface_text: the first respondent along With his sons filed O. S. No. 18 of 1937 in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Darjeeling, for the recovery of half of the loss incurred in the transactions with Mulchand.

facts.text: In the plaint of 1937 suit, reserved right to claim further amounts re Mulchand after accounts settled.

anchor.surface_text: In the plaint he reserved his right to claim any further amount in respect of transactions with Mulchand that might be found due to him after the accounts were finally settled with him.

facts.text: 1937 suit referred to arbitration, Subordinate Judge decreed Rs. 3,375 to first respondent and sons.

anchor.surface_text: That suit was referred to arbitration and on the basis of the award, the Subordinate Judge made a decree in favour of the first respondent and his sons for a sum of Rs. 3,375.

facts.text: After final accounts settled and payments made to Hapur merchants, first respondent instituted Money Suit No. 5 of 1940 for Rs. 5,300 with interest.

anchor.surface_text: After the final accounts were settled between the first respondent and the two merchants of Hapur and after the amounts due to them were paid, the first respondent instituted a suit, out of which the present appeal arises, in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Darjeeling, for the recovery of a sum of Rs. 5,300 with interest thereon.

facts.text: Plaint amended to claim relief on basis that firm dissolved.
